title: KBW maintains ‘Outperform’ rating on Riot Platforms with $35 price target following Anthropic deal
excerpt: A single prospective tenant is negotiating for Riot’s entire Corsicana site. A definitive lease could exceed $1 billion in annual rent, but key commercial te...
content_html:
Riot (NASDAQ: RIOT) has entered into a non-binding letter of intent with a single prospective tenant for the full 756 MW of planned net critical IT capacity at its Corsicana, Texas, site, KBW analyst Stephen Glagola said Tuesday.

KBW maintained its Outperform rating and $35 price target on Riot. The target implies an 80.4% projected total return from the $19.40 share price cited in the note.

The agreement could become Riot's second large AI data-center lease following its 191 MW Rockdale transaction. However, Riot has not disclosed the prospective tenant, rental rate or credit support, and the LOI remains subject to further technical and commercial work.

Corsicana offers 756 MW of critical IT capacity

Corsicana sits on Riot-owned land with 1 GW of fully approved utility power, which could support 756 MW of net critical IT capacity. The ERCOT site has a direct 345-kV transmission interconnection and is not subject to the batch interconnection process discussed during Riot's second-quarter call.

KBW said the secured power and limited permitting exposure could give Corsicana a time-to-power advantage. Riot is also procuring long-lead equipment while advancing a 168 MW core-and-shell building designed for high-density AI/HPC workloads.

Riot began fully marketing Corsicana at the start of 2026 after securing additional acreage and completing a development plan. Management expects the potential lease to run for 15 to 20 years, making the delivery schedule and design requirements material parts of the negotiation.

"While an LOI is not a signed lease, this milestone reflects the depth of demand for large-scale, fully approved power in today's market and the confidence prospective tenants have in Riot's ability to deliver," Chief Executive Officer Jason Les said during the August 10 earnings call.

Full deployment could exceed $1 billion in annual rent

Riot said a lease covering the entire Corsicana site could generate more than $1 billion of annual rent once fully deployed. That figure is a management estimate rather than contracted revenue, and Riot has not announced a definitive construction budget or development financing plan for the site.

The scale would exceed Riot's two executed Rockdale leases, which cover 241 MW of contracted critical IT capacity. AMD accounts for 50 MW, while an unnamed frontier AI lab–reported to be Anthropic–has signed a 20-year lease for a custom-built 191 MW Tier III facility.

Riot expects the AI-lab lease to produce approximately $9.1 billion of revenue during its initial term. The company estimates cumulative net operating income of $7.3 billion to $8.2 billion, equal to average annual NOI of $365 million to $411 million.

content_html_zh:
KBW 分析师 Stephen Glagola 周二表示，Riot（纳斯达克股票代码：RIOT）已与一位潜在租户就其德克萨斯州科西卡纳基地规划的 756 兆瓦关键 IT 净容量签订了一份不具约束力的意向书。

KBW 维持 Riot 的跑赢大盘评级和 35 美元的目标价。 该目标意味着报告中提到的 19.40 美元股价的预计总回报率为 80.4%。

该协议可能成为 Riot 继 Rockdale 191 MW 交易之后的第二个大型人工智能数据中心租赁协议。 不过，Riot 尚未透露潜在租户、租金率或信贷支持，意向书仍有待进一步的技术和商业工作。

Corsicana 提供 756 MW 的关键 IT 容量

Corsicana 坐落在 Riot 拥有的土地上，拥有 1 GW 完全批准的公用事业电力，可支持 756 MW 的净关键 IT 容量。 ERCOT 站点具有直接的 345 kV 输电互连，不受 Riot 第二季度电话会议中讨论的批量互连过程的影响。

KBW 表示，安全的电力和有限的许可曝光可能会给科西卡纳带来电力时间优势。 Riot 还在采购长期设备，同时推进专为高密度 AI/HPC 工作负载设计的 168 MW 核心壳建筑。

在获得额外面积并完成开发计划后，Riot 于 2026 年初开始全面营销科西卡纳。 管理层预计潜在租约将持续 15 至 20 年，从而使交付时间表和设计要求成为谈判的重要组成部分。

首席执行官杰森·莱斯 (Jason Les) 在 8 月 10 日的财报电话会议上表示：“虽然意向书不是签署的租约，但这一里程碑反映了当今市场对大规模、完全批准电力的需求深度，以及潜在租户对 Riot 交付能力的信心。”

全面部署年租金可能超过 10 亿美元

Riot表示，覆盖整个科西卡纳场地的租约一旦全面部署，每年可产生超过10亿美元的租金。 这个数字是管理层的估计，而不是合同收入，Riot 尚未宣布该网站的明确建设预算或开发融资计划。

这一规模将超过 Riot 在 Rockdale 执行的两项租赁合同，其中涵盖了 241 MW 的合同关键 IT 容量。 AMD 拥有 50 MW，而一家未命名的前沿人工智能实验室（据报道为 Anthropic）已签署了一份为期 20 年的租约，用于定制 191 MW Tier III 设施。

Riot 预计人工智能实验室租赁在其初始期限内将产生约 91 亿美元的收入。 该公司预计累计净营业收入为 73 亿至 82 亿美元，相当于年平均 NOI 为 3.65 亿至 4.11 亿美元。
